---
name: risk-register
description: Identify, score and track project risks with mitigations. Use during planning and update each sprint.
---

# Risk register

| ID | Risk | Category (tech/schedule/scope/people/external) | Likelihood 1-5 | Impact 1-5 | Score | Mitigation | Contingency | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Score = likelihood x impact. >= 15 high: needs a mitigation task in the plan and visibility in Open Decisions. 8-14 medium: monitor. Prefer mitigations that become concrete tasks or spikes scheduled early. Re-score at each sprint review.
